temperature = 27.21 degC with stated absolute uncertainty 0.1 degC
measured_resistance = 10.638 mOhm with stated absolute uncertainty 0.1 mOhm
channel_voltage_difference = 0.014219 V, while the stated absolute uncertainty on this metric is 0.1 V (uncertainty exceeds the reading, so this value is not discriminating as given)
rest_voltage_change = -7.631 mV with stated absolute uncertainty 0.1 mV
charge_energy = 12.538 Wh with stated absolute uncertainty 0.1 Wh
All listed observations carry empty quality_flags and share one timestamp (2026-09-02T10:00:00Z), one instrument, and one synthetic method; they are not independent measurement channels

unknowns: Asset metadata reports observation_complete_cycle = false and soc_endpoints_equal = false, so the measured_capacity of 5.0397 Ah is not established as a comparable full-cycle capacity against the frozen reference
Asset metadata reports quality = low and sensor_level = vehicle; no independent reference instrument or repeat observation is visible
The SOH prediction head (q05 0.82201, q50 0.92201, q95 1.02201) is flagged unvalidated_synthetic with support insufficient_data, so it is not a calibrated fault probability
No calibrated likelihood, loss, or VOI inputs are available, so no numerical fault probability can be stated
Whether the temperature/load condition at 27.21 degC and 0.325C is comparable to the condition under which the frozen reference capacity was established is not visible
No root cause is confirmed; the relationship between the resistance, voltage-difference, rest-voltage, and capacity readings is not independently verified

reasons: Configured synthetic predictions are not validated numerical fault likelihoods
Observation set is single-timestamp, single-instrument, incomplete-cycle evidence with low stated quality

Repeat of the same acquisition source would assess reproducibility of the single-timestamp readings; catalogue marks it as needing new authorization, so it is proposed for human confirmation only
Catalogue check listed as pending new authorization; proposed for human review only, not selected for execution

priority.reason: Visible evidence is a single-timestamp, low-quality, incomplete-cycle synthetic set with uncalibrated predictions; an authorized alignment/channel check is warranted, but no fault is confirmed and no test is dispatched automatically
